title: Pricing of Clinic Services Outside the Included List
content:
A service that is not on the included list of a Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans plan is billed at the clinic list price less the plan's discount on services not included in the plan. A spay or neuter surgery is billed at list price less the plan's spay or neuter discount instead — never both discounts on one service. The billed amount, that is the list price reduced by the applicable percentage, is rounded half up to the cent. Tailwise Plus Premier perk credit may pay the rest of the billed amount where the plan accepts perk credit. Discounts are suspended while the plan is past due.

## Discount table

| Plan | Discount on services not included | Spay or neuter discount | Tailwise Plus Premier perk credit accepted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 10% | 20% | Yes |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | 10% | 20% | Yes |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 10% | 0% | Yes |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 10% | 0% | Yes |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | 15% | 0% | Yes |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | 15% | 0% | Yes |

Discounts apply while the plan is Active and are suspended while the plan is Past due.

## Worked billing (hypothetical list prices)

| Plan and service | List price | Percentage applied | Billed amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan, a service not included | 50.05 | 10% | 45.045, rounded half up to 45.05 |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan, a service not included | 87.45 | 15% | 74.3325, rounded half up to 74.33 |
| Puppy Wellness Plan, neuter surgery | 400.00 | 20% (the spay or neuter discount only) | 320.00 |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan, neuter surgery | 400.00 | 0% (the spay or neuter discount only) | 400.00 |

The two neuter rows follow from "instead, never both": the spay or neuter discount takes the place of the discount on services not included, so under a plan whose spay or neuter discount is 0%, the surgery is billed at list price.

## Perk credit

Where perk credit is accepted — under all six plans — Tailwise Plus Premier perk credit may pay the rest, the amount billed after the plan discount. In the first worked row, that rest is 45.05.

## Status

| Plan status | Plan discount on a service outside the included list |
|---|---|
| Active | Applies |
| Past due | Suspended |
